credits.title: Raging Moms
credits.overview: Amidst sweating attacks, sex escapades, existential fears and the unsuccessful fight against the signs of the times, four women search for happiness and find themselves.

credits.title: Skill Issue
credits.overview: Simon spends a summer day by the river with Enes's clique, whom he knows from the neighborhood. Between moments of uncertainty and sluggish conversations, the hours slip by. But then Marie shows up and Simon is suddenly wide awake.

credits.title: Breakage
credits.overview: After committing a robbery, three young criminals plan their next heist. The euphoria of those first moments gradually gives way to repressed longings and conflicting emotions. They begin to have doubts about their plan.

credits.title: Quick'n'Clean
credits.overview: Ria is a young girl working at a dry cleaner's. Not much to expect here, apart from the fact that she's expecting. It's ten minutes before the shop closes, when her boyfriend Lenny steps in to hide a mysterious suitcase. He's looking for a safe harbour while she makes a quick and clean decision.
